headlines.title: 凯投宏观：日本7月PMI显示经济未受石油冲击影响
headlines.summary: 金十数据7月24日讯，凯投宏观亚洲首席经济学家Marcel Thieliant表示，日本采购经理人指数(PMI)初值数据表明，该国经济继续摆脱能源成本冲击的影响。日本经济保持韧性，并且依然预示着通胀将急剧加速。7月份综合PMI从52.8微升至53.1的四个月高点，这与约1.5%的高于趋势水平的GDP增长率相一致。Thieliant补充说，这一改善很难解释，因为服务业和制造业PMI均有所疲软。他认为，这可能是因为日本终于开始受益于对人工智能相关产品更强劲的需求。

headlines.title_en: Capital Economics: Japan's July PMI Shows Economy Unaffected by Oil Shock
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, July 24 - Marcel Thieliant, Chief Asia Economist at Capital Economics, said that the preliminary Japanese PMI data indicates that the economy continues to shake off the impact of energy cost shocks. The Japanese economy remains resilient, still suggesting a sharp acceleration in inflation. The July Composite PMI edged up to a four-month high of 53.1 from 52.8, consistent with GDP growth of about 1.5% above trend. Thieliant added that this improvement is hard to explain because both the services and manufacturing PMIs softened. He believes it may be because Japan is finally starting to benefit from stronger demand for AI-related products.

headlines.summary: 7月以来已有近540家上市公司接待机构调研，其中超110家公司预计上半年净利润同比增长，部分业绩高增标的获得机构密集关注。近期A股进入调整阶段，对于后市走势，业内人士认为，在政策支持以及科技产业趋势仍在发展的背景下，未来市场情绪或逐步修复。对于科技板块，需要在波浪式前进中把握投资节奏，消费板块开始逐步具备配置价值，此外进入“击球区”的黄金也值得关注。（中证报）

headlines.title_en: Since July, Institutions Have Surveyed Nearly 540 Listed Companies; Several High-Performance Stocks Become Favorites
headlines.summary_en: Since July, nearly 540 listed companies have hosted institutional research visits, of which over 110 expect a year-on-year increase in net profit for the first half of the year. Some companies with high performance growth have received intensive institutional attention. As A-shares enter an adjustment phase, industry insiders believe that with policy support and ongoing tech industry trends, market sentiment may gradually improve. For the tech sector, investment rhythm needs to be grasped amidst fluctuations; the consumer sector is starting to show allocation value, and gold, entering the 'sweet spot,' is also worth attention. (China Securities Journal)

headlines.title: 今年上半年中国汽车出口超6000亿元，同比增长48.3%
headlines.summary: 今年上半年，我国汽车出口6358.2亿元，同比增长48.3%，销往全球210多个国家和地区。其中，新能源汽车出口3606.8亿元，同比增长68.7%。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: China's Auto Exports Exceed 600 Billion Yuan in H1, Up 48.3% YoY
headlines.summary_en: In the first half of this year, China's auto exports totaled 635.82 billion yuan, up 48.3% year-on-year, reaching over 210 countries and regions. Among them, new energy vehicle exports were 360.68 billion yuan, up 68.7% year-on-year. (CCTV News)

headlines.title: 卡尼：针对美关税威胁，将“不惜一切代价”维护利益
headlines.summary: 据加拿大媒体报道，加拿大总理马克·卡尼23日表示，针对美国政府近期发出的关税威胁，加拿大政府将“不惜一切代价”维护本国利益。 卡尼当天在爱德华王子岛省夏洛特敦举行的全国地方领导人会议闭幕致辞中说，面对美方关税施压，加拿大政府将坚决保护和支持本国工人、农民、企业及家庭。

headlines.title_en: Carney: Will Protect Interests 'At All Costs' Against US Tariff Threats
headlines.summary_en: According to Canadian media reports, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said on the 23rd that the Canadian government will 'do whatever it takes' to defend national interests in response to recent US tariff threats. Speaking at the closing address of the national local leaders' conference in Charlottetown, Prince Edward Island, Carney stated that the government will firmly protect and support Canadian workers, farmers, businesses, and families in the face of US tariff pressure.

headlines.title: A股科技板块持续调整，机构关注资源品与红利低位股
headlines.summary: 近期，A股科技板块明显调整，市场风险偏好有所回落。Wind数据显示，截至7月23日的近3个交易日，有色金属、电气设备、石油石化等板块率先获得资金回流，消费、红利和金融板块则呈现结构性机会。机构认为，本轮调整更多是外部扰动、交易拥挤和估值压力集中释放的结果，市场中长期运行逻辑并未发生根本变化。在半年报密集披露的窗口期，资金正由前期高弹性、高估值的方向，逐步转向业绩确定性更强、估值更具安全边际的板块。（中证报）

headlines.title_en: A-share tech sector continues to adjust; institutions focus on resource goods and low-position dividend stocks
headlines.summary_en: Recently, the A-share tech sector has seen a notable correction, with market risk appetite retreating. Wind data shows that in the past three trading days to July 23, sectors like non-ferrous metals, electrical equipment, and petroleum & petrochemicals first saw capital inflows, while consumer, dividend, and financial sectors showed structural opportunities. Institutions believe this round of adjustment is more a result of external disruptions, crowded trades, and concentrated release of valuation pressure, with no fundamental change in the market's medium- to long-term logic. During the peak period of semi-annual report disclosures, capital is shifting from high-elasticity, high-valuation directions to sectors with stronger earnings certainty and more valuation safety margins. (China Securities Journal)
